title: Stock evaluator gates
description: The gate grammar of the stock evaluator (`cannery evaluator`), evaluated against tester-verified measurements. No expressions, scripts or queries. Cannery Row itself evaluates no gate.

per_dimension.description: Evaluate for every value of this dimension; passes only if all pass.

statistic.description: Which number of the measurement is compared.

compare.description: What the statistic is compared against.

min_delta.description: Required difference statistic - reference, in the direction of op.
